name: ModelVariant95_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant95_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a textured sphere grows on one of the slot's parts and flies to a point in front of it, then a widening beam of quads streams towards the other slot behind an optional screen flash); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request and packs two texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 until the beam starts, 4 while it lasts, 1 on the first frame after that and 2 later; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-112 and 242 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
